            "text": "    private boolean toggle(String etype, String eid, long uid, String metric, int idx, boolean add) {",

          {
            "text": "        // 固定分片定位：按用户 ID 映射到 chunk 与分片内 bit 偏移，避免单键膨胀与热点 TODO 单键膨胀与热点是什么",

          },

          },
          {

            "text": "            -- 把计算后的十进制数字重新变成 4 字节的二进制“乱码”，准备塞回 Redis。",

            "text": "     * 找到某个 metric + entity 的所有 bitmap 分片，对每个分片执行 BITCOUNT，把结果加起来，得到“真实计数",

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "        // 生产环境建议以索引集合替代 KEYS",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 548
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 550
          },

            "text": "        // 管道批量 BITCOUNT 汇总",

          },
          {
            "text": "        List&lt;Object&gt; res = redis.executePipelined((RedisCallback&lt;Object&gt;) connection -&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 552
          },
          {
            "text": "            for (String k : keys) {",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 554
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 555
          },
          {
            "text": "            return null;",
            "lineNumber": 556
          },
          {
            "text": "        });",
            "lineNumber": 557
          },
          {
            "text": "        long sum = 0L;",
            "lineNumber": 558
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 559
          },
          {
            "text": "        for (Object o : res) {",

          },
          {

          },

          },

            "text": "            }",

          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 564
          },

            "text": "        return sum;",

            "lineNumber": 566
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 567
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Redis 内嵌 Lua（Redis 5/6 的 Lua 5.1），位图原子切换（分片内偏移）",
            "lineNumber": 568
          },
          {
            "text": "    // 位图本质：Redis位图是一个二进制字符串，每个字节 8 位",

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 580
          },
          {
            "text": "            local prev = redis.call('GETBIT', bmKey, offset)",

          {

            "lineNumber": 582
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 基于当前事件类型，以及当前值判断是否需要操作，若需要操作返回 1 ，若无需操作返回 0 ，若异常返回 -1",
            "lineNumber": 583
          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 计数系统设计方案（位图 + 事件聚合 + SDS）",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1. 目标与边界",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "- 统一支持内容实体的点赞、收藏等高并发计数；用户维度支持关注、粉丝、发文、获赞、获收藏。",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "- 写入需幂等、读低延迟、整体秒级最终一致；遇到异常可自动重建，保证数据纠偏能力。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- 成本与性能平衡：以内存占用低、CPU 分布均衡为目标，避免数据库热写与 Redis 哈希膨胀。",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2. 架构总览",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- 写路径（状态事实为位图，增量事件异步折叠到汇总）：",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 位图切换（Lua 原子 &#96;SETBIT&#96;）→ 仅在状态变化时产出计数事件 → Kafka &#96;counter-events&#96; → 聚合桶（Redis Hash）持久化增量 → 定时刷写到 SDS 固定结构计数。",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- 读路径（优先读汇总，异常时回溯事实）：",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 常规读：直接读取 SDS 固定结构计数",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 异常读：SDS 缺失或结构异常时，用位图分片 &#96;BITCOUNT&#96; 真实重建；分布式锁保护并清理对应聚合字段，避免重复加算。",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户维度计数通过关系 Outbox 事件处理器异步维护，并提供按需重建与抽样校验。",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "用户动作 → 位图切换(原子) → 计数事件 → Kafka",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "                                     ↓",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "                                聚合增量桶(Hash) ← 手动位点确认",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "                                     ↓ (fixedDelay=1s)",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "                             刷写到汇总(SDS) ← 原子 Lua 更新",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "读取计数：优先 SDS；异常：位图重建 + 分布式锁 + 清理聚合字段",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "核心代码参考：",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- 位图切换与事件产出：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/service/impl/CounterServiceImpl.java:61-75&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- 聚合增量消费与刷写：",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Kafka 增量入桶：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/event/CounterAggregationConsumer.java:33-46&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 定时刷写到 SDS：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/event/CounterAggregationConsumer.java:48-104&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- 读路径与异常重建：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/service/impl/CounterServiceImpl.java:77-125&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户维度异步维护：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/relation/processor/RelationEventProcessor.java:44-58&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          }
        ]
      },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "## 3. 数据模型与键设计",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- 实体计数（内容维度）",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 位图分片：&#96;bm:{metric}:{etype}:{eid}:{chunk}&#96;，分片位数 &#96;32768&#96;（4KB/分片）；&#96;chunk=userId/32768&#96;，&#96;bit=userId%32768&#96;（&#96;BitmapShard.java:8-16&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 汇总计数（SDS 固定结构）：&#96;cnt:{schema}:{etype}:{eid}&#96;，&#96;schema=v1&#96;，段长 &#96;FIELD_SIZE=4&#96; 字节，段数 &#96;SCHEMA_LEN=5&#96;；大端 32 位整型编码（&#96;CounterSchema.java:17-24&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 聚合增量桶：&#96;agg:{schema}:{etype}:{eid}&#96;（Hash），&#96;field=idx&#96;，&#96;value=delta&#96;（&#96;CounterKeys.java:16-22&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 重建锁：&#96;lock:sds-rebuild:{etype}:{eid}&#96;，TTL 5s 防并发（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:197-205&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户计数（用户维度，SDS）",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;ucnt:{userId}&#96;，共 5 段×4 字节：",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    1. 关注数 followings",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    2. 粉丝数 followers",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "    3. 发文数 posts",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "    4. 获赞数 likesReceived",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    5. 获收藏数 favsReceived",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 增量原子折叠 Lua，1 基坐标（&#96;UserCounterServiceImpl.java:31-59,97-122&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "- Kafka 主题：&#96;counter-events&#96;（&#96;CounterTopics.java:3-5&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "## 4. 写路径详解",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- 位图切换（幂等原子）：",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Lua &#96;TOGGLE_LUA&#96;：当且仅当状态发生变化时置 1/清 0，返回 1 表示变更；否则返回 0（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:249-265&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 成功变更后产出事件并发布到 Kafka，同步触发本地 Spring 事件供缓存失效等用途（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:69-73&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "- 聚合增量消费：",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Kafka 消费计数事件，&#96;HINCRBY agg:{schema}:{etype}:{eid} field=idx value=delta&#96;；写桶成功后手动位点确认（&#96;CounterAggregationConsumer.java:33-46&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "- 定时刷写到 SDS：",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 每 1 秒固定延迟扫描聚合桶键，原子执行 Lua &#96;INCR_FIELD_LUA&#96; 将增量折叠至对应 SDS 段并删除字段，避免重复加算（&#96;CounterAggregationConsumer.java:48-104,106-136&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 58
          }
        ]
      },

          {
            "text": "    @KafkaListener(topics = CounterTopics.EVENTS, groupId = \"counter-agg\")",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    public void onMessage(String message, Acknowledgment ack) throws Exception {",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 读取队列中的事件，JSON 转换回 Java 计数事件对象",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        CounterEvent evt = objectMapper.readValue(message, CounterEvent.class);",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 基于实体事件类型 + 实体事件 ID 构建对应聚合桶的 Key",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        String aggKey = CounterKeys.aggKey(evt.getEntityType(), evt.getEntityId());",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "        // like / fav 对应的 indexId ： like 1 、fav 2",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "        String field = String.valueOf(evt.getIdx());",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "        try {",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 将增量持久化到 Redis Hash 中对应的 field 中，like 1 、fav 2",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "            redis.opsForHash().increment(aggKey, field, evt.getDelta());",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 成功后提交位点，绑定“已持久化”语义",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "            ack.acknowledge();",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        } catch (Exception ex) {",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 不提交位点以便重试",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "    /**",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 将聚合增量刷写到 SDS 固定结构计数",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 固定延迟 1s，保证秒级最终一致性 TODO 是如何保证的",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "     * Spring框架的定时任务注解",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 方法每执行完一次后，延迟 1000 毫秒（1秒）再执行下一次，确保每次执行之间有 1 秒间隔",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "     * fixedDelay：上次任务结束时间到下次任务开始时间的固定间隔",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 单位：毫秒（1000L表示1000毫秒）",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "     */",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\用户关系设计方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 58
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 125,
            "column": 2
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### 3.2 索引策略",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用联合索引 &#96;from_user_id + created_at&#96; 和 &#96;to_user_id + created_at&#96; 以支持分页查询。",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- 覆盖索引减少回表，提升查询性能。",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- 针对关系判定建立唯一索引避免重复关注。",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "## 四、伪从同步机制",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.1 实现方式",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- following表作为主表，follower表通过伪从消费其Binlog或消息事件实现同步。",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- 同步逻辑：",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCreated&#96; → 插入 follower 记录",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCanceled&#96; → 更新 rel_status=0 或删除记录",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "- 幂等保证：以 &#96;(from_user_id,to_user_id)&#96; 作为唯一键去重。",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.2 Outbox + 消费者机制（推荐）",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "- 在following表事务中插入Outbox记录。",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "- CDC组件（Canal/Debezium）或自研消费者监听Outbox并发送MQ事件。",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "- follower表、计数服务、缓存服务均从MQ订阅更新。",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "## 五、计数模块设计",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.1 数据结构",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用Redis **SDS二进制结构**实现紧凑存储。",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "- Key：&#96;ucnt:{userId}&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "- Value：5个Int5字段，分别表示：",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. 关注数",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. 粉丝数",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. 用户作品数",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "  4. 用户点赞作品数",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "  5. 用户收藏作品数",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.2 同步机制",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "- 消费 &#96;FollowCreated/FollowCanceled&#96; 事件自动更新计数。",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "- Redis Lua脚本原子自增/自减。",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "- 定期对账任务比对数据库计数差异并修正。",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "## 六、缓存设计",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.1 列表缓存",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "- 关注列表：&#96;uf:flws:{userId}&#96; → ZSet(to_user_id, created_at)",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "- 粉丝列表：&#96;uf:fans:{userId}&#96; → ZSet(from_user_id, created_at)",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "- 仅缓存最近N条记录（如1000条）。",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "- 大V用户（粉丝&gt;50W）使用本地Caffeine缓存保存Top 500。",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.2 一致性更新",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "- 消费事件异步更新ZSet缓存：",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCreated&#96; → &#96;ZADD&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCanceled&#96; → &#96;ZREM&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "- 当缓存不存在时，DB分页查询并回填Redis。",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.3 Key TTL",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "- 列表缓存TTL：1~6小时。",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "- 计数缓存：永久存储，由事件维护。",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "## 七、限流设计",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "### 7.1 令牌桶算法",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "- 每个用户关注操作独立令牌桶：&#96;rl:follow:{userId}&#96;。",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "- 容量100，填充速率1/s。",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用Lua脚本原子取令牌：",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 126
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4497247040271759
    },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tongji\\counter\\event\\CounterRebuildConsumer.java",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 78,
            "column": 64
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 143,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    private static final String INCR_FIELD_LUA = \"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- Redis 的键名",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "            local cntKey = KEYS[1]",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 预定义的字段总数",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "            local schemaLen = tonumber(ARGV[1])",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 每个字段占用的字节数，固定为4",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "            local fieldSize = tonumber(ARGV[2])",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 目标字段的索引（从 0 开始）",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "            local idx = tonumber(ARGV[3])",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 要增加或减少的数值",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "            local delta = tonumber(ARGV[4])",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 从字符串的某个位置连续取出 4 个字节，拼成一个正常的十进制数字。",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "            local function read32be(s, off)",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 字节数组中，Lua 索引是从 1 开始（假如有 20 字节，索引是从 1-20），脚本中 off + 1 处理了偏移",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- string.byte 返回字符串从 off+1 到 off+4 ，得到包含这四个字节的字节数组",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 如果 idx = 2 ，则读取位置 9 - 12 字节",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "              local b = {string.byte(s, off+1, off+4)}",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "              local n = 0",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 大端序计算：高位在前，通过不断乘以 256（即左移 8 位）累加",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 大端序计算就是读取四字节可以得到一个十进制的数",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 赋值给 n",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "              for i=1,4 do n = n * 256 + b[i] end",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "              return n",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "            end",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 将十进制数字转换回 4 字节的大端序二进制字符串，修改完原值实现了增量",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "            local function write32be(n)",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 倒序计算：通过取模和整除，把数字拆解回 4 个字节",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "              local t = {}",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "              for i=4,1,-1 do t[i] = n % 256; n = math.floor(n/256) end",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- string.char 将字节数组转回二进制字符串",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "              return string.char(unpack(t))",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "            end",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 1. 获取当前 Key 的对应的 value 值",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "            local cnt = redis.call('GET', cntKey)",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 2. 初始化：初始化全零字符串。当key不存在时，创建长度为 schemaLen * 4的全 0 二进制串",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "            if not cnt then cnt = string.rep(string.char(0), schemaLen * fieldSize) end",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 3. 定位偏移量：索引 * 4。例如 idx 为 2，则跳过前 8 字节",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "            local off = idx * fieldSize",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 4. 核心计算：读出旧值 + 增量",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "            local v = read32be(cnt, off) + delta",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 5. 边界保护：防止数值变成负数（类似电商库存不为负的逻辑）",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "            if v &lt; 0 then v = 0 end",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 6. 返回得到 4 字节的二进制字符串",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "            local seg = write32be(v)",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 7. 字符串重组：",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 使用截取函数：[开头到偏移位] + [新修改的4字节] + [偏移位+4之后的所有内容]",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "            cnt = string.sub(cnt, 1, off) .. seg .. string.sub(cnt, off+fieldSize+1)",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 8. 存入 Redis",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "            redis.call('SET', cntKey, cnt)",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 返回成功标识",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "            return 1",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"\"\";",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 144
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4477860927581787
    },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tongji\\counter\\service\\impl\\CounterServiceImpl.java",

            "text": "    @Override",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "    public Map&lt;String, Long&gt; getCounts(String entityType, String entityId, List&lt;String&gt; metrics) {",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 一、检查数据完整性",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 构建该 entityType+entityId 对应的计数 Key",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "        String sdsKey = CounterKeys.sdsKey(entityType, entityId);",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 计算预期的位数",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "        int expectedLen = CounterSchema.SCHEMA_LEN * CounterSchema.FIELD_SIZE;",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Redis 的 value 是一个 string（SDS），但其内部是一个自定义的二进制数组",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 每个计数字段固定占 4 字节",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 字段值使用 32-bit 整数表示，并且统一采用大端字节序存储。",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 读取 SDS 原始字节",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "        // SDS 固定结构：按大端 32 位编码",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "        byte[] raw = getRaw(sdsKey);",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 判断读取的字节数是否符合预期",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "        boolean needRebuild = (raw == null || raw.length != expectedLen);",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 存储结果",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },

            "text": "    private boolean isBigV(long userId, int idx) {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        // 获取该用户，用于用户维度计数的字节数组",
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "        byte[] raw = redis.execute((RedisCallback&lt;byte[]&gt;) c -&gt; c.stringCommands().get((\"ucnt:\" + userId).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 390

            "lineNumber": 391

            "text": "        long n = 0;",
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 计算偏移量",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "text": "        int off = (idx - 1) * 4;",
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 获取对应位置的计数器，将字节数组中的对应部分，转换成十进制数",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },
          {
            "text": "        for (int i = 0; i &lt; 4; i++) n = (n &lt;&lt; 8) | (raw[off + i] &amp; 0xFFL); // &amp;0xFFL 确保每一部分都被当作无符号数处理",
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 判断总数是否大于等于 50w ，也就是判断是否是大 V",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "text": "        return n &gt;= 500_000L;",
            "lineNumber": 398
          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tongji\\counter\\event\\CounterRebuildConsumer.java",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 78,

          },

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    private static final String INCR_FIELD_LUA = \"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- Redis 的键名",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "            local cntKey = KEYS[1]",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 预定义的字段总数",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "            local schemaLen = tonumber(ARGV[1])",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 每个字段占用的字节数，固定为4",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "            local fieldSize = tonumber(ARGV[2])",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 目标字段的索引（从 0 开始）",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "            local idx = tonumber(ARGV[3])",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 要增加或减少的数值",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "            local delta = tonumber(ARGV[4])",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 从字符串的某个位置连续取出 4 个字节，拼成一个正常的十进制数字。",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "            local function read32be(s, off)",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 字节数组中，Lua 索引是从 1 开始（假如有 20 字节，索引是从 1-20），脚本中 off + 1 处理了偏移",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- string.byte 返回字符串从 off+1 到 off+4 ，得到包含这四个字节的字节数组",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 如果 idx = 2 ，则读取位置 9 - 12 字节",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "              local b = {string.byte(s, off+1, off+4)}",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "              local n = 0",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 大端序计算：高位在前，通过不断乘以 256（即左移 8 位）累加",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 大端序计算就是读取四字节可以得到一个十进制的数",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 赋值给 n",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "              for i=1,4 do n = n * 256 + b[i] end",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "              return n",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "            end",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 将十进制数字转换回 4 字节的大端序二进制字符串，修改完原值实现了增量",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "            local function write32be(n)",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 倒序计算：通过取模和整除，把数字拆解回 4 个字节",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "              local t = {}",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "              for i=4,1,-1 do t[i] = n % 256; n = math.floor(n/256) end",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- string.char 将字节数组转回二进制字符串",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "              return string.char(unpack(t))",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "            end",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 1. 获取当前 Key 的对应的 value 值",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "            local cnt = redis.call('GET', cntKey)",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 2. 初始化：初始化全零字符串。当key不存在时，创建长度为 schemaLen * 4的全 0 二进制串",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "            if not cnt then cnt = string.rep(string.char(0), schemaLen * fieldSize) end",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 3. 定位偏移量：索引 * 4。例如 idx 为 2，则跳过前 8 字节",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "            local off = idx * fieldSize",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 4. 核心计算：读出旧值 + 增量",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "            local v = read32be(cnt, off) + delta",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 5. 边界保护：防止数值变成负数（类似电商库存不为负的逻辑）",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "            if v &lt; 0 then v = 0 end",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 6. 返回得到 4 字节的二进制字符串",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "            local seg = write32be(v)",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 7. 字符串重组：",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 使用截取函数：[开头到偏移位] + [新修改的4字节] + [偏移位+4之后的所有内容]",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "            cnt = string.sub(cnt, 1, off) .. seg .. string.sub(cnt, off+fieldSize+1)",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 8. 存入 Redis",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "            redis.call('SET', cntKey, cnt)",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 返回成功标识",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "            return 1",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"\"\";",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 144
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3761838674545288
    },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\计数系统设计方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 32
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 计数系统设计方案（位图 + 事件聚合 + SDS）",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1. 目标与边界",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "- 统一支持内容实体的点赞、收藏等高并发计数；用户维度支持关注、粉丝、发文、获赞、获收藏。",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "- 写入需幂等、读低延迟、整体秒级最终一致；遇到异常可自动重建，保证数据纠偏能力。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- 成本与性能平衡：以内存占用低、CPU 分布均衡为目标，避免数据库热写与 Redis 哈希膨胀。",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2. 架构总览",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- 写路径（状态事实为位图，增量事件异步折叠到汇总）：",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 位图切换（Lua 原子 &#96;SETBIT&#96;）→ 仅在状态变化时产出计数事件 → Kafka &#96;counter-events&#96; → 聚合桶（Redis Hash）持久化增量 → 定时刷写到 SDS 固定结构计数。",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- 读路径（优先读汇总，异常时回溯事实）：",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 常规读：直接读取 SDS 固定结构计数",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 异常读：SDS 缺失或结构异常时，用位图分片 &#96;BITCOUNT&#96; 真实重建；分布式锁保护并清理对应聚合字段，避免重复加算。",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户维度计数通过关系 Outbox 事件处理器异步维护，并提供按需重建与抽样校验。",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "用户动作 → 位图切换(原子) → 计数事件 → Kafka",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "                                     ↓",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "                                聚合增量桶(Hash) ← 手动位点确认",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "                                     ↓ (fixedDelay=1s)",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "                             刷写到汇总(SDS) ← 原子 Lua 更新",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "读取计数：优先 SDS；异常：位图重建 + 分布式锁 + 清理聚合字段",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "核心代码参考：",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- 位图切换与事件产出：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/service/impl/CounterServiceImpl.java:61-75&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- 聚合增量消费与刷写：",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Kafka 增量入桶：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/event/CounterAggregationConsumer.java:33-46&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 定时刷写到 SDS：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/event/CounterAggregationConsumer.java:48-104&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- 读路径与异常重建：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/service/impl/CounterServiceImpl.java:77-125&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户维度异步维护：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/relation/processor/RelationEventProcessor.java:44-58&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          }
        ]
      },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\计数系统设计方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 78
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 106
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- 原子折叠与上下限：",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Lua 折叠时小于 0 归 0，避免负计数；当前采用 4 字节有符号上限，未来可平滑扩展段大小（&#96;CounterAggregationConsumer.java:130-135&#96; 与 &#96;CounterSchema.java:17-24&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "- 并发保护：",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "  - SDS 重建加分布式锁，避免并发回写；成功重建后清理对应聚合字段，杜绝重复计入（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:87-110,197-205&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "- 灾备：",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 可切换重建消费者做全量事件回放；Kafka 生产端开启幂等与严格确认（参见 &#96;application.yml&#96; 的 producer 配置）。",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "## 7. 调度与配置",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "- 调度开关：&#96;@EnableScheduling&#96;（&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/config/CounterConfig.java:14&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "- 聚合刷写：&#96;@Scheduled(fixedDelay = 1000L)&#96;（&#96;CounterAggregationConsumer.java:48-49&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "- 热键窗口轮转（与 Feed 缓存相关）：&#96;@Scheduled(fixedRateString = \"${cache.hotkey.segment-seconds:10}000\")&#96;（&#96;HotKeyDetector.java:68&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "## 8. 方案对比",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "- 直接写 Redis Hash 计数（HINCRBY）",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 优点：简单、读写一致；缺点：高写压、哈希膨胀、无“事实层”纠偏，幂等难以保证。",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "- 仅位图 + 读时 BITCOUNT",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 优点：事实唯一可信；缺点：读时开销大（多分片 BITCOUNT），批量场景 RTT 与 CPU 高。",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "- 数据库计数列（UPDATE/乐观锁）",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 优点：事务一致；缺点：数据库成为写热点，扩展性差，缓存回填复杂。",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "- 本方案（位图事实 + 事件聚合 + SDS 汇总）",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 优点：写入幂等、读低延迟、具备事实回溯与自动纠偏、内存占用小、批量友好；",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 代价：秒级最终一致、需要后台刷写与键空间管理。",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "## 9. 优势与取舍",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "- 高并发安全：Lua 原子切换 + 幂等事件，避免重复计入。",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "- 强纠偏能力：SDS 异常时可依据位图真实重建；灾备可事件回放。",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "- 低成本与高吞吐：SDS 固定结构（20 字节）提升读性能与局部性；聚合刷写降低写放大。",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "- 易扩展：&#96;schema=v1&#96; 可增加指标、调整段大小；键约定清晰易维护。",
            "lineNumber": 106
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.32538971304893494
    },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tongji\\counter\\event\\CounterRebuildConsumer.java",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 56,
            "column": 7
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 142,
            "column": 12
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    @KafkaListener(topics = CounterTopics.EVENTS, groupId = \"counter-rebuild\", properties = {\"auto.offset.reset=earliest\"})",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "    public void onMessage(String message, Acknowledgment ack) throws Exception {",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 灾备场景：从最早位点回放历史事件，直接折叠到 SDS",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "        // JSON 转换回 Java 对象",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        CounterEvent evt = objectMapper.readValue(message, CounterEvent.class);",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 得到 Redis Key",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        String cntKey = CounterKeys.sdsKey(evt.getEntityType(), evt.getEntityId());",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        try {",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 传入参数，执行 Lua 脚本",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "            redis.execute(incrScript, List.of(cntKey),",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "                    String.valueOf(CounterSchema.SCHEMA_LEN),",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "                    String.valueOf(CounterSchema.FIELD_SIZE),",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "                    String.valueOf(evt.getIdx()),",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "                    String.valueOf(evt.getDelta()));",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "            ack.acknowledge(); // 写入成功后提交位点，避免重复回放",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "        } catch (Exception ex) {",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 不提交位点以便重试",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "    // 复用与聚合消费者一致的原子计数折叠脚本",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "    private static final String INCR_FIELD_LUA = \"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- Redis 的键名",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "            local cntKey = KEYS[1]",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 预定义的字段总数",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "            local schemaLen = tonumber(ARGV[1])",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 每个字段占用的字节数，固定为4",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "            local fieldSize = tonumber(ARGV[2])",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 目标字段的索引（从 0 开始）",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "            local idx = tonumber(ARGV[3])",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 要增加或减少的数值",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "            local delta = tonumber(ARGV[4])",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 从字符串的某个位置连续取出 4 个字节，拼成一个正常的十进制数字。",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "            local function read32be(s, off)",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 字节数组中，Lua 索引是从 1 开始（假如有 20 字节，索引是从 1-20），脚本中 off + 1 处理了偏移",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- string.byte 返回字符串从 off+1 到 off+4 ，得到包含这四个字节的字节数组",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 如果 idx = 2 ，则读取位置 9 - 12 字节",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "              local b = {string.byte(s, off+1, off+4)}",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "              local n = 0",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 大端序计算：高位在前，通过不断乘以 256（即左移 8 位）累加",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 大端序计算就是读取四字节可以得到一个十进制的数",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 赋值给 n",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "              for i=1,4 do n = n * 256 + b[i] end",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "              return n",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "            end",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 将十进制数字转换回 4 字节的大端序二进制字符串，修改完原值实现了增量",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "            local function write32be(n)",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- 倒序计算：通过取模和整除，把数字拆解回 4 个字节",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "              local t = {}",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "              for i=4,1,-1 do t[i] = n % 256; n = math.floor(n/256) end",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "              -- string.char 将字节数组转回二进制字符串",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "              return string.char(unpack(t))",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "            end",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 1. 获取当前 Key 的对应的 value 值",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "            local cnt = redis.call('GET', cntKey)",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 2. 初始化：初始化全零字符串。当key不存在时，创建长度为 schemaLen * 4的全 0 二进制串",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "            if not cnt then cnt = string.rep(string.char(0), schemaLen * fieldSize) end",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 3. 定位偏移量：索引 * 4。例如 idx 为 2，则跳过前 8 字节",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "            local off = idx * fieldSize",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 4. 核心计算：读出旧值 + 增量",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "            local v = read32be(cnt, off) + delta",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 5. 边界保护：防止数值变成负数（类似电商库存不为负的逻辑）",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "            if v &lt; 0 then v = 0 end",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 6. 返回得到 4 字节的二进制字符串",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "            local seg = write32be(v)",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 7. 字符串重组：",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 使用截取函数：[开头到偏移位] + [新修改的4字节] + [偏移位+4之后的所有内容]",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "            cnt = string.sub(cnt, 1, off) .. seg .. string.sub(cnt, off+fieldSize+1)",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 8. 存入 Redis",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "            redis.call('SET', cntKey, cnt)",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 返回成功标识",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "            return 1",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 143
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.32115229964256287
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\计数系统设计方案.md",
        "range": {

          },

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- 读路径与异常重建：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/service/impl/CounterServiceImpl.java:77-125&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户维度异步维护：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/relation/processor/RelationEventProcessor.java:44-58&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- 灾备全量回放：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/event/CounterRebuildConsumer.java:35-53&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "## 3. 数据模型与键设计",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- 实体计数（内容维度）",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 位图分片：&#96;bm:{metric}:{etype}:{eid}:{chunk}&#96;，分片位数 &#96;32768&#96;（4KB/分片）；&#96;chunk=userId/32768&#96;，&#96;bit=userId%32768&#96;（&#96;BitmapShard.java:8-16&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 汇总计数（SDS 固定结构）：&#96;cnt:{schema}:{etype}:{eid}&#96;，&#96;schema=v1&#96;，段长 &#96;FIELD_SIZE=4&#96; 字节，段数 &#96;SCHEMA_LEN=5&#96;；大端 32 位整型编码（&#96;CounterSchema.java:17-24&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 聚合增量桶：&#96;agg:{schema}:{etype}:{eid}&#96;（Hash），&#96;field=idx&#96;，&#96;value=delta&#96;（&#96;CounterKeys.java:16-22&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 重建锁：&#96;lock:sds-rebuild:{etype}:{eid}&#96;，TTL 5s 防并发（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:197-205&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户计数（用户维度，SDS）",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;ucnt:{userId}&#96;，共 5 段×4 字节：",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    1. 关注数 followings",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    2. 粉丝数 followers",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "    3. 发文数 posts",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "    4. 获赞数 likesReceived",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    5. 获收藏数 favsReceived",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 增量原子折叠 Lua，1 基坐标（&#96;UserCounterServiceImpl.java:31-59,97-122&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "- Kafka 主题：&#96;counter-events&#96;（&#96;CounterTopics.java:3-5&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "## 4. 写路径详解",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- 位图切换（幂等原子）：",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Lua &#96;TOGGLE_LUA&#96;：当且仅当状态发生变化时置 1/清 0，返回 1 表示变更；否则返回 0（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:249-265&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 成功变更后产出事件并发布到 Kafka，同步触发本地 Spring 事件供缓存失效等用途（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:69-73&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "- 聚合增量消费：",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Kafka 消费计数事件，&#96;HINCRBY agg:{schema}:{etype}:{eid} field=idx value=delta&#96;；写桶成功后手动位点确认（&#96;CounterAggregationConsumer.java:33-46&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "- 定时刷写到 SDS：",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 每 1 秒固定延迟扫描聚合桶键，原子执行 Lua &#96;INCR_FIELD_LUA&#96; 将增量折叠至对应 SDS 段并删除字段，避免重复加算（&#96;CounterAggregationConsumer.java:48-104,106-136&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 58
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3179974853992462
    },

      "codeBlock": {

          {
            "text": "            boolean locked = false;",
            "lineNumber": 219

          {
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "            try {",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "                // 使用 Redisson 看门狗机制：不指定租期，自动续约（由 Redisson 的 lockWatchdogTimeout 控制）",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "                // 0ms：立刻抢锁，抢不到就算了，不阻塞等待。",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "                locked = lock.tryLock(0L, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "                if (!locked) {",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "                    // 没获取到锁，指数退避，结果返回默认值 0",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "                    for (String m : metrics) {",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "                    }",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "                }",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "                // 获取到锁",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "                // 依据位图分片统计真实计数（仅由持锁者执行重建）",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "                byte[] newSds = new byte[expectedLen];",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "                // 遍历 metrics，按 schema 找字段 idx",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "                    // 获取对应索引：like 1 | fav 2",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "                    Integer idx = CounterSchema.NAME_TO_IDX.get(m);",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "                    // 把这个 entity 的 bitmap 分片全部 BITCOUNT / 统计后加总，得到“真实计数”。",

          },

          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tongji\\counter\\service\\impl\\CounterServiceImpl.java",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    private static void writeInt32BE(byte[] buf, int off, long val) {",
            "lineNumber": 530
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 下限保护，如果 val &lt; 0 → 写成 0",
            "lineNumber": 531
          },
          {
            "text": "        long n = Math.max(0, Math.min(val, 0xFFFF_FFFFL));",
            "lineNumber": 532
          },
          {
            "text": "        buf[off] = (byte) ((n &gt;&gt;&gt; 24) &amp; 0xFF);",
            "lineNumber": 533
          },
          {
            "text": "        buf[off + 1] = (byte) ((n &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xFF);",
            "lineNumber": 534
          },
          {
            "text": "        buf[off + 2] = (byte) ((n &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xFF);",
            "lineNumber": 535
          },
          {
            "text": "        buf[off + 3] = (byte) (n &amp; 0xFF);",
            "lineNumber": 536
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 537
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 538
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 539
          },
          {
            "text": "    /**",
            "lineNumber": 540
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 基于位图分片进行管道化 BITCOUNT 汇总，用于按事实重建计数。",
            "lineNumber": 541
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 说明：当前使用 KEYS 枚举分片（生产建议维护索引集合），结果按分片 BITCOUNT 求和。",
            "lineNumber": 542
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 找到某个 metric + entity 的所有 bitmap 分片，对每个分片执行 BITCOUNT，把结果加起来，得到“真实计数",
            "lineNumber": 543
          },
          {
            "text": "     */",
            "lineNumber": 544
          },
          {
            "text": "    private long bitCountShardsPipelined(String metric, String etype, String eid) {",
            "lineNumber": 545
          },
          {
            "text": "        String pattern = String.format(\"bm:%s:%s:%s:*\", metric, etype, eid);",
            "lineNumber": 546
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 生产环境建议以索引集合替代 KEYS",
            "lineNumber": 547
          },
          {
            "text": "        Set&lt;String&gt; keys = redis.keys(pattern); ",
            "lineNumber": 548
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (keys.isEmpty()) return 0L;",
            "lineNumber": 549
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 550
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 管道批量 BITCOUNT 汇总",
            "lineNumber": 551
          },
          {
            "text": "        List&lt;Object&gt; res = redis.executePipelined((RedisCallback&lt;Object&gt;) connection -&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 552
          },
          {
            "text": "            for (String k : keys) {",
            "lineNumber": 553
          },
          {
            "text": "                connection.stringCommands().bitCount(k.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));",
            "lineNumber": 554
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 555
          },
          {
            "text": "            return null;",
            "lineNumber": 556
          },
          {
            "text": "        });",
            "lineNumber": 557
          },
          {
            "text": "        long sum = 0L;",
            "lineNumber": 558
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 559
          },
          {
            "text": "        for (Object o : res) {",
            "lineNumber": 560
          },
          {
            "text": "            if (o instanceof Number n) {",
            "lineNumber": 561
          },
          {
            "text": "                sum += n.longValue();",
            "lineNumber": 562
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 563
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 564
          },
          {
            "text": "        return sum;",
            "lineNumber": 565
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 566
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 567
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Redis 内嵌 Lua（Redis 5/6 的 Lua 5.1），位图原子切换（分片内偏移）",
            "lineNumber": 568
          },
          {
            "text": "    // 位图本质：Redis位图是一个二进制字符串，每个字节 8 位",
            "lineNumber": 569
          },
          {
            "text": "    private static final String TOGGLE_LUA = \"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 570
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 对应的分片 key",
            "lineNumber": 571
          },
          {
            "text": "            local bmKey = KEYS[1]",
            "lineNumber": 572
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 573
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 分片中的偏移量",
            "lineNumber": 574
          },
          {
            "text": "            local offset = tonumber(ARGV[1])",
            "lineNumber": 575
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 576
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 'add' or 'remove'",
            "lineNumber": 577
          },
          {
            "text": "            local op = ARGV[2]",
            "lineNumber": 578
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 579
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 获取当前偏移量对应的值 1 还是 0 （已点赞/未点赞）",
            "lineNumber": 580
          },
          {
            "text": "            local prev = redis.call('GETBIT', bmKey, offset)",
            "lineNumber": 581
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 582
          },
          {
            "text": "            -- 基于当前事件类型，以及当前值判断是否需要操作，若需要操作返回 1 ，若无需操作返回 0 ，若异常返回 -1",
            "lineNumber": 583
          },
          {
            "text": "            if op == 'add' then",
            "lineNumber": 584
          },
          {
            "text": "              if prev == 1 then return 0 end",
            "lineNumber": 585
          },
          {
            "text": "              redis.call('SETBIT', bmKey, offset, 1)",
            "lineNumber": 586
          },
          {
            "text": "              return 1",
            "lineNumber": 587
          },
          {
            "text": "            elseif op == 'remove' then",
            "lineNumber": 588
          },
          {
            "text": "              if prev == 0 then return 0 end",
            "lineNumber": 589
          },
          {
            "text": "              redis.call('SETBIT', bmKey, offset, 0)",
            "lineNumber": 590
          },
          {
            "text": "              return 1",
            "lineNumber": 591
          },
          {
            "text": "            end",
            "lineNumber": 592
          },
          {
            "text": "            return -1",
            "lineNumber": 593
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 594
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.304431289434433
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\计数系统设计方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 56
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 80
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- 定时刷写到 SDS：",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 每 1 秒固定延迟扫描聚合桶键，原子执行 Lua &#96;INCR_FIELD_LUA&#96; 将增量折叠至对应 SDS 段并删除字段，避免重复加算（&#96;CounterAggregationConsumer.java:48-104,106-136&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "- 灾备全量回放（可选）：",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;counter.rebuild.enabled=true&#96; 时，使用 earliest 回放历史事件直接折叠到 SDS，确保在严重异常后可恢复（&#96;CounterRebuildConsumer.java:15-21,35-53&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "## 5. 读路径详解",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- 常规读取（单 ID）：",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;GET cnt:{schema}:{etype}:{eid}&#96;，按照 Schema 偏移读取段值（大端 32 位），O(1)；若结构匹配则直接返回（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:115-125,212-226&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- 异常重建：",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "  - SDS 缺失或长度异常时，先尝试获取分布式锁；对请求的指标逐一 &#96;BITCOUNT bm:{metric}:{etype}:{eid}:*&#96;（管道批量）求和，拼出新 SDS，回写并清理对应聚合字段（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:87-110,228-247&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "- 批量读取（Feed 场景）：",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 管道批量 &#96;GET&#96; 多个 SDS 键，缺失时补 0，避免逐条 RTT（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:127-163&#96;）；",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Feed 汇总与“是否点赞/收藏”判定集成：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/knowpost/service/impl/KnowPostFeedServiceImpl.java:294-323&#96;。",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户维度读取与校验：",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;GET ucnt:{userId}&#96;，异常时调用服务重建；抽样校验每 300s 对关注/粉丝做数据库对比，不一致则重建（&#96;RelationController.java:105-178&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "## 6. 一致性、幂等与容错",

          },
          {
            "text": "- 幂等来源：",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 位图切换脚本仅在状态变化时返回成功，事件仅在变更时产出（&#96;CounterServiceImpl.java:61-75,249-265&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 关系事件处理使用 Redis 去重键（TTL 10 分钟）保证幂等（&#96;RelationEventProcessor.java:26-33&#96;）。",

          },
          {
            "text": "- 最终一致：",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 写入至聚合桶后至刷写的窗口为秒级（&#96;fixedDelay=1000ms&#96;），在窗口内读可能略滞后；异常情况下触发“事实重建”确保正确性。",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "- 原子折叠与上下限：",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Lua 折叠时小于 0 归 0，避免负计数；当前采用 4 字节有符号上限，未来可平滑扩展段大小（&#96;CounterAggregationConsumer.java:130-135&#96; 与 &#96;CounterSchema.java:17-24&#96;）。",
            "lineNumber": 80
          }

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "        // 判断读取的字节数是否符合预期",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 182
          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "        // 当发现数据需要重建时，为了防止成千上万个请求同时去重建（导致 Redis 挂掉），需做严密的保护：",

          },
          {
            "text": "        // inBackoff：检查是否在“退避期”。如果刚失败过，降级，直接返回 0，不折腾 Redis",

          },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 189

            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {

          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tongji\\counter\\event\\CounterRebuildConsumer.java",
